description: This is a Python source file defining configuration settings for an application. It loads environment variables, provides functions to retrieve and validate environment variables, and encapsulates the application settings within the Settings dataclass.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable data class holding application configuration loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: str _get_required_env(name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a required environment variable, raising an error if missing.

methods.name: int _get_int_env(name: str, default: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable and converts it to an integer, or returns a default value.

methods.name: List[str] _parse_csv_env(name: str, default: str)
methods.description: Parses a CSV environment variable into a list of strings.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads and validates application settings from environment variables, returning a Settings instance.
